# Hello Shade (custom window shades)

> Hello Shade (helloshade.co) is an online store for custom window shades. Not to be confused with other businesses using the name. Hello Shade sells custom window shades online (Roller, Roman, Zebra, Woven), made to measure for each window and at the customer's house in 2–3 weeks. No showroom and no home visit: customers try shades on in a room on the site, then text a designer who helps them pick, measure and order. Shades start at $209; a 36×60″ Roller is $229. Facts on this page were updated 2026-11-10. Live prices and products as JSON: https://helloshade.co/feed.json

Key facts:
- Types and From prices (24×24″): Roller $209, Zebra $239 (estimate), Roman $259, Woven $269.
- At 36×60″: Roller $229, Zebra $259 (estimate), Roman $329, Roman with room-darkening lining $359, Woven $399.
- Price is set by type and size; fabric and color don't change it. Each window is priced separately. Same prices for everyone.
- Sizes: 12–96″ wide, 12–120″ high. Larger or unusual windows are quoted by text.
- Samples: up to 5 fabrics for $10, credited to the shade order.
- Customers measure themselves with a regular tape, and a designer checks every number before anything is made.
- Customers install themselves with two brackets and a drill. Hello Shade doesn't install.
